vatRegulation.title: Sales tax regulation

tooltips.standard: Standard taxable sales with regular tax rates (0%, 7%, or 19%). The most common regulation for domestic B2B and B2C transactions.
tooltips.taxExempt4: Use this regulation for services exempt from VAT under §4 No. 8–29 UStG. For example, if you provide insurance services or practice a healing profession. This revenue is reported in field 48 of the preliminary VAT return.
tooltips.reverseCharge13b: For certain domestic services, the tax liability shifts to the recipient (§13b UStG). Applies e.g. to construction work, building cleaning, or mobile device deliveries over €5,000. You do not charge VAT — the recipient owes it.
tooltips.reverseCharge18b: For services to businesses in another EU member state (B2B). The tax liability shifts to the recipient. Requires: The customer must have a valid VAT ID. Must be reported in the EC Sales List (Zusammenfassende Meldung).
tooltips.intraCommunityDelivery: Tax-free delivery of goods to a business in another EU member state (§4 No. 1b in conjunction with §6a UStG). Requires: valid VAT ID of the recipient and proof of transport (arrival certificate).
tooltips.oss: One-Stop-Shop (OSS) for cross-border sales of goods and certain services to consumers (B2C) within the EU. The VAT rate of the destination country applies. Reporting is done quarterly via the Federal Central Tax Office (BZSt).
tooltips.export: Tax-free export delivery to recipients outside the EU (§4 No. 1a in conjunction with §6 UStG). Requires: export proof (e.g. customs certificate). Reported in field 43 of the preliminary VAT return.
tooltips.nonDomesticService: Services where the place of supply under §3a UStG is not in Germany, e.g. consulting services for businesses in Switzerland, the USA, or other non-EU countries. No German VAT is charged.
tooltips.smallBusiness19: As a small business owner according to §19 UStG, no sales tax is charged. This setting is set in company settings.

legalNotice.reverseCharge13b: VAT liability shifted to the recipient pursuant to §13b UStG.
legalNotice.reverseCharge18b: VAT liability shifted to the recipient pursuant to §18b UStG. The VAT must be declared and paid by the recipient.
legalNotice.intraCommunityDelivery: Tax-free intra-community delivery pursuant to §4 No. 1b in conjunction with §6a UStG.
legalNotice.oss: Taxation under the One-Stop-Shop (OSS) procedure pursuant to §18j UStG.
legalNotice.export: Tax-free export delivery pursuant to §4 No. 1a in conjunction with §6 UStG.
legalNotice.nonDomesticService: Service not taxable in Germany pursuant to §3a UStG.
legalNotice.smallBusiness19: According to §19 UStG, no sales tax is charged.

inviteDialog.defaultMessage:
I'm using zoonox to issue invoices, capture documents and run my bookkeeping. Zoonox offers a free tax advisor portal.

There you'll find current financial reports, booking overviews and all documents. You can use the export to import my data into your firm software (DATEV). With direct access you can review my books live, leave comments and release months.

The link below grants you access to {workspace}.

Kind regards
{inviter}
